==========================================
Operator names after member access
==========================================

struct X { bool operator==(const X &) const; int operator()(int) const; };
void f(X x, X *px) {
  x.operator==(x);
  px->operator()(1);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
          (operator_name)
          (parameter_list
            (parameter_declaration
              (type_qualifier)
              (type_identifier)
              (abstract_reference_declarator)))
          (type_qualifier)))
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (function_declarator
          (operator_name)
          (parameter_list
            (parameter_declaration
              (primitive_type)))
          (type_qualifier)))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (field_expression
            (identifier)
            (operator_name))
          (argument_list
            (identifier))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (field_expression
            (identifier)
            (operator_name))
          (argument_list
            (number_literal)))))))

==========================================
Pointer-to-member access
==========================================

struct F { int field; };
void f(F *config, int F::*fieldp) {
  config->*fieldp;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (struct_specifier
    (type_identifier)
    (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (field_identifier))))
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (type_identifier)
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (qualified_identifier
            (namespace_identifier)
            (pointer_type_declarator
              (type_identifier))))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (field_expression
          (identifier)
          (field_identifier))))))

==========================================
Array of pointers with new
==========================================

void f(int n) {
  int **p = new int*[n];
  delete[] p;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement
      (declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (init_declarator
          (pointer_declarator
            (pointer_declarator
              (identifier)))
          (new_expression
            (primitive_type)
            (new_declarator
              (new_declarator
                (identifier))))))
      (expression_statement
        (delete_expression
          (identifier))))))

==========================================
Simple array new still works (control)
==========================================

void f(int n) {
  int *p = new int[n];
  delete[] p;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type)
          (identifier))))
    (compound_statement
      (declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (init_declarator
          (pointer_declarator
            (identifier))
          (new_expression
            (primitive_type)
            (new_declarator
              (identifier)))))
      (expression_statement
        (delete_expression
          (identifier))))))

==========================================
Functional cast to a dependent type as a call argument
==========================================

void g(...);
template <class S> void f() { g(typename S::First()); }
template <class S> void h() { auto x = typename S::First{}; }

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list)))
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier)))
    (function_definition
      (primitive_type)
      (function_declarator
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (compound_statement
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (argument_list
              (call_expression
                (dependent_type
                  (qualified_identifier
                    (namespace_identifier)
                    (type_identifier)))
                (argument_list))))))))
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (type_parameter_declaration
        (type_identifier)))
    (function_definition
      (primitive_type)
      (function_declarator
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list))
      (compound_statement
        (declaration
          (placeholder_type_specifier
            (auto))
          (init_declarator
            (identifier)
            (compound_literal_expression
              (dependent_type
                (qualified_identifier
                  (namespace_identifier)
                  (type_identifier)))
              (initializer_list))))))))
